name: Naoshima

quotes.text:
If you have time and can get there: you should absolutely go to Naoshima Island. And specifically the Chichu Museum. It is my favorite place I have been to on planet earth. 

www.japan-guide.com/e/e5475.html

How cool! I had never heard of Naoshima, the Art Island. I had to look it up and found there are 3 Art Islands in Japan: Japan’s art islands: Naoshima, Teshima and Inujima. I would love to explore them!

This is a Yayoi Kusama pumpkin I saw at Naoshima Island Japan. It is a wonderful art island we visited on one of my trips. This pumpkin was blown away out to see by a typhoon. So glad I got to see it.
I missed my ferry to Naoshima in Japan. Not as good a view as yours and a two hour wait.
